theorem: An arbitrary finite two-counter program has exact deterministic VM semantics whose every macro-step is wrapped in a W33 route of at most two hops, while carrier type and the two order-51840 symmetry domains remain explicit and nonconflated.

universal_core.counters: unbounded natural numbers in the abstract semantics
universal_core.reason: two-counter machines are a standard universal model of computation

honesty_boundary: Turing-complete is a statement about the abstract VM semantics, not one finite physical W33 device.
Unbounded counters require scalable recursive/external storage in an implementation.
Sp(4,3) and PGSp(4,3) ~= W(E6) have the same order but are distinct extensions and distinct VM namespaces.
The 216 carrier is immutable machine type, not a runtime gauge bit.
Quantum universality still requires a separately validated non-Clifford physical port.
